questions.stem: Two point charges separated by distance $r$ repel each other with force $F$. If one charge is doubled and the separation is halved, the new force is

options.whyWrong: Only the doubled charge was counted. The halved distance was ignored.
Only the halved distance was counted. The doubled charge was ignored.
Treated the force as $\propto 1/r$, so halving $r$ only doubled $F$ and seemed to cancel.

questions.solution:
**Key idea:** $F \propto \dfrac{q_1 q_2}{r^2}$, so write the ratio.

$\dfrac{F'}{F} = 2 \times \left(\dfrac{r}{r/2}\right)^2 = 2 \times 4 = 8$

**$F' = 8F$**
hints: Write $F'/F$ as a product of ratios.
